title: A goose in the grass
excerpt: A playful goose, lots of green, and the joy of painting something that feels alive.
body:
This goose started as a small, silly idea — a bird mid-wiggle in fresh grass.

I used to post drawings like this on Instagram as @zradni_sarra: cute animals, quiet humour, nothing too serious. The stall still lives in that same place. Acrylic on canvas, greens mixed until they felt like spring, and a goose that looks like it might hop off the easel.

I do not change the painting for the shop or for this note. What you see is the piece as it was painted.
